observations.title: World record for African figure seals a good year for African and Oceanic Art at Sotheby's, Paris
observations.page_title: World record for African figure seals a good year for African and Oceanic Art at Sotheby’s, Paris
observations.page_description: Sotheby’s Arts d’Afrique et d’Océanie sale in Paris on 11 December 2013 confirmed the saleroom's position as the past year’s top venue for African, Oceanic and Pre-Columbian art.
